articles.summary: Tiptree Inc. (NASDAQ:TIPT) (“Tiptree” or the “Company”), today announced its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025. Third Quarter 2025 Highlights On September 26, 2025, the Company agreed to sell Fortegra for $1.65 billion, with $1.12 billion estimated gross proceeds to Tiptree pending regulatory approvals. Anticipated closing of the Fortegra transaction in mid-2026. On October 31, 2025, the Company agreed to sell its mortgage business, Reliance First Capital,
articles.title: Tiptree Announces Third Quarter 2025 Results and Sale of Reliance First Capital
